rulings.why: The page tells these changes from the row (`can`), or the judge could not tell (`unclear`), but no check of the shape readings does: moveup:4.6: can: The header on p307-strip0.jpg prints 7.6.7.6.D. Stanza 4's line 6 is the last 6 syllables of the fourth row of system 3 (p307-strip800.jpg) and line 7 opens the fourth row of system 4 (p307-strip1600.jpg) with 7 syllables; moving line 7's first word up makes them 7 and 6, which the printed metre breaks (the capitals alone would not show it: the moved word follows an exclamation mark and the new opener is a divine pronoun).
